title: Sakina guzar gayi
body:
baba ko rone waali sakina guzar gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan may ye ghul hai haan ye ghazab hua
saakit hai nafs haye bachi ko kya hua
kyun sard dasht e paa hai sakina guzar gayi hai
baba ko rone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko yaad karke din raat rone waali
khamosh kyun padi hai dukh dard sehne waali
har bibi ro rahi hai sakina guzar gayi hai
baba ko rone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ke gham may bachi jee bhar ke ro na paayi
haan ye shaki ke darr se zindan may so na paayi
ab kaisi bekasi hai sakina guzar gayi hai
baba ko rone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe sone waali ab khaak pe padi hai
zindan ka andhera kya usko kha gayi hai
abid tadap rahe hai sakina guzar gayi hai
baba ko rone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ka kata sar jab zindan may wo paayi
hasrat se ro ke boli mushkil hai ab judaai
mehsoos phir hua hai sakina guzar gayi hai
baba ko rone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chaar saal bachi aur baalon may safedi
kano se khoon hai jaari zakhmon may choor qaidi
zindan may mar gayi hai sakina guzar gayi hai
baba ko rone waali...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan may qayamat hai shor e girya matam
ahsan tadap tadap ke likhta hai ab ye aazam
zindan laraz raha hai sakina guzar gayi hai
baba ko rone waali...
author: Azam Hussain
